{{Quote|I'm Senator Tobas Grell. My daughter and I are from Sarkhai; we only just joined the Republic.|Tobas Grell|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Tobas Grell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented his [[Sarkhai/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The father of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nadia Grell]], Grell was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] as the [[Galactic War]] began at the close of the Cold War.

==Biography==
{{Quote|To the institute of Xenozoology, if they can display it. But finally, my most important concern. My dear Nadia. She is so gifted. But these "Children of the Emperor" are both gifted and trained. Therefore, I ask Nadia be accepted for a padawan's training and taught by the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order.|Tobas Grell's last message|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] native of his people's [[Sarkhai/Legends|homeworld]], Tobas Grell spent his younger years traveling the isolated planet exploring ruins of past civilizations lost in the dense jungles. Marrying a young woman named [[Maykia Grell|Maykia]], Grell ended his career as an explorer when his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] became pregnant with their daughter [[Nadia Grell|Nadia]]. When his wife died in childbirth, Grell dedicated his life to his daughter and ascended to a high rank in the Sarkhai royal court to ensure that she would be well cared for. During this time Grell's daughter began demonstrating [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and he was forced to defend her from the superstitions of his peers and co-workers.<ref name="TORE" />

When Sarkhai joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], Grell was appointed as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] for the Sarkhai planetary government. While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Grell and his delegation were approached by the [[Rift Alliance]] at the height of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Alliance, a coalition of disillusioned worlds, were successful in gaining Grell's support and funding from Sarkhai. In an attempt to mend the gap between the Alliance and the Republic, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] arranged a meeting with Alliance leaders but did not foresee and [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt by the Sith Empire.<ref name="TORE" />

While the assassins were nearly successful, Grell and the other leaders were protected by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the Jedi Order who was aided by Grell's daughter, Nadia. The Alliance took advantage of the Jedi Order's protection and were able to free [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Following the successes at Balmorra, Grell spoke with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and told him of the situation on [[Attis Station]], a secret installation of the Alliance's, despite the others wanting to keep it secret. Revealing his daughter's Force-sensitivity to the Barsen'thor, Grell continued to aid the Jedi in his quest to consolidate the Alliance and keep them aligned with the Republic.<ref name="TOR" />

On the eve of a renewed war, Grell and the Rift Alliance were tasked with mustering an army to push back the Empire. After much research, they went to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in order to awake the sleeping army called the [[Esh-kha]]. While the Barsen'thor was planetside awaking them, Grell was on the orbital station where he would be the victim of an abduction. Followed by the Barsen'thor and his daughter Nadia, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Stark]] executed the Senator while torturing him for information about the Rift Alliance's plans.<ref name="TOR" />

Having feared such a thing may occur, Senator Grell left a will with the Jedi Order before his death. At least one subject was concerning the [[Institute of Xenozoology]], while the final part of his will concerned his daughter. Requesting that his ally the Barsen'thor of the Jedi Order take his daughter under his tutelage, Grell hoped that Nadia would grow to become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. In line with Sarkhai law, Nadia Grell inherited her father's seat in the Senate as well.<ref name="TOR" />
